summary.text: John Barrasso was sworn in to the U.S. Senate in 2007 and was re-elected in November 2024; he serves as Senate Republican whip.

paragraphs.text: He served in the Wyoming State Senate from 2003 to 2007 representing Natrona County.
He worked for 24 years as an orthopedic surgeon and lives in Casper, Wyoming.
